mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Pantheon has bonus Armor and Magic Resist.
Pantheon is invulnerable to attacks from the front and striking rapidly.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Pantheon braces his shield and engages enemies in a chosen direction for @ShieldDuration@ seconds, becoming immune to non-tower damage from that direction and dealing @DamageCalc@ physical damage over the duration. After channeling Pantheon slams with his shield, dealing @ShieldDamageCalc@ physical damage.

Mortal Will Bonus: When Pantheon slams his shield he gains @ResistsCalc@ Armor and @ResistsCalc@ Magic Resist for @ResistsDuration@ seconds, and @SpeedAmount*100@% Move Speed for @SpeedDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Recast to end early (Pantheon still slams with his shield as the last hit).
Damage to minions is reduced by @MinionDamageReduction*100@%.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: After using @ActionsToEmpower@ Abilities or Attacks, Pantheon empowers his next basic Ability.
Pantheon is stacking towards an empowered spell.
Pantheon's next base spell is empowered.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Pantheon either thrusts his spear or throws his spear in the chosen direction.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Tap: Pantheon thrusts his spear, dealing @TapDamageCalc@ physical damage to enemies hit. Refunds @TapCooldownRefund*100@% of this Ability's Cooldown.

Hold: Pantheon hurls his spear, dealing @HoldDamageCalc@ physical damage to the first enemy hit and @DamageFalloff*100@% less to further targets.

This Ability is enhanced against enemies below @CritHealthThreshold*100@% Health to deal @ExecuteDamageCalcModified@ physical damage instead.

Mortal Will Bonus: Deals an additional @EmpoweredDamageCalc@ physical damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Deals @MonsterDamageMod*100@% damage to monsters.
Deals @MinionDamageMod*100@% damage to minions.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Pantheon composes himself and then leaps into the air, landing at a chosen location as a comet.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Pantheon gains @ArmorPenetration*100@% Armor Penetration.

Active: Pantheon gathers his strength to leap high into the air. He throws his spear from above which in a small area deals @spell.PantheonQ:HoldDamageCalc@ physical damage and Slows by @SpearSlow*100@% for @SpearSlowDuration@ seconds.

Pantheon then crashes down as a meteor at the target area. Deals up to @DamageCalc@ magic damage to enemies in a line (decreased by up to @EdgeDamageReduction*100@% at the edges of the area).

This Ability instantly readies Mortal Will.
This unit's Move Speed is reduced.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Pantheon dashes to a target, damaging and stunning them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Pantheon leaps on his target, Stunning for @StunDuration@ second and dealing @MaxHealthDamageCalc@ max Health physical damage.

Mortal Will Bonus: Pantheon's next Attack strikes @EmpoweredNumHits@ times, dealing a total of @EmpoweredDamageMultCalcModified@ physical damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Deals a minimum of @MonsterDamageMin@ and a maximum of @MonsterDamageCap@ damage to Minions and Monsters.</rules>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Pantheon's next basic attack is empowered.
